rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges B-grade ICM/A-grade TE, but it overstates visible certainty by suggesting possible early hatching/expansion 3–4 despite lab data specifying 3BA and relies on features not fully verifiable from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, BMI, endometrium, semen parameters, prior cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis tied to embryo grade and patient factors; minor issue is some hedging/inconsistency around exact expansion stage and probability framing.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor overreach includes speculative emphasis on paternal age/SDF without a stronger indication.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and when to consider further sperm or uterine evaluation.
